Node.js 24.0.0 (Current)

By the Node.js release team

This release updates the V8 JavaScript engine to 13.6 & upgrades npm to version 11, and it promotes several features to stable.

Share this post on every network

Notable changes

The URLPattern API is now a global — you use it without an import.

The permission model flag changes from --experimental-permission to --permission, and it is no longer experimental.

  • Float16Array
  • RegExp.escape — at last
  • Explicit resource management with <using>
